verdict.title: Cart accepts negative item quantities and calculates a negative total
verdict.oneLiner: The cart accepted a quantity of -3 for the Ash Glaze Mug and displayed a total of $-84.00.
verdict.rootCause: The cart does not block a negative quantity or restore the item quantity to 1. It uses the negative value to calculate the line item, cart total, and header count.
verdict.suggestion: Reject quantities below 1 on update, show a clear validation message, keep the existing valid quantity, and prevent negative values from affecting the header count or totals.

flow.title: Cart rejects a negative quantity
steps: Wait for the "Added to cart" message
Clear the Quantity field for the Ash Glaze Mug and type -3
expect: The cart Total is not a negative amount
The Ash Glaze Mug quantity is not negative: either an error message is shown or the quantity stays at 1
The cart count in the header is not a negative number
flow.notes: Breaker's suspicion: POST /api/cart/update (server.js:285-294) only rejects NaN and treats 0 as a removal. Any other parseInt result, including negatives, is stored as-is. The min="1" on the input (server.js:147) is only a browser hint, so subtotal, total and header count go negative (rendered as '$-84.00').
